result.title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
result.summary: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PnP-Transformer，用可微、免迭代的神经位姿求解器替代经典 PnP-RANSAC：输入带置信度的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场，将几何输入映射到连续 latent 空间并回归 6D 位姿，在 BOP 七个数据集上取得 41.2% 平均 AR，但同等对应模块下 EPnP-RANSAC 反而更准、仅多耗 60ms。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域较远，但其将几何证据与置信度聚合进连续 latent 状态、以及「学到的 latent 回归与经典显式搜索的精度-延迟权衡」这一负结果，可能可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选与计算成本评价的参照。
